title: Publisher identity
description: Publisher identity (spec 10847). Identity is an Ed25519 public key plus the metadata a consumer needs to decide whether to trust it; it is NOT a reputation score. Marketplace-first section 7.2 REFUTED publisher reputation for a one-user estate and that refutation is adopted here: there is no `stars`, no `downloads`, no `rating`. What remains is the part that is falsifiable -- can this key verify this signature, and is this key in the trust policy.

status.description: `compromised` is stronger than `retired`: mkt.identity refuses EVERY signature from a compromised key, including signatures made before the compromise was declared, because the compromise date cannot be trusted to be earlier than the forgery.

role.description: Capability separation. Only `registry-maintainer` may sign the index; only `moderator` may close a moderation case; only `security-response` may sign an advisory. One key that can do all three is one key whose loss ends the marketplace.
